Department of Pathology
ICMR HBCR (POCSS) PROJECT
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram
Advertisement for post of Medical Social Worker in Project on
Hospital Based Cancer Registry (HBCR) with additional
Patterns of Care and Survival Studies (POCSS)
The candidate for the following position will be hired purely on contract basis for an ICMR project being implemented by the Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram with financial support & technical leads from the National Institute of NCD Epidemiology (NINE), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Bengaluru.
The candidate will be hired purely on contract basis and will not be considered as employee of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram or the ICMR. The project may be terminated at any time in between without any prior intimation.
Project: HOSPITAL BASED CANCER REGISTRY (HBCR) WITH PATTERNS OF CARE AND SURVIVAL STUDIES (POCSS)
Duration: Two years. However, the initial contract will be for six months from the date of joining.
Medical Social Worker- Number of positions: 01
1   Qualifications  :  Bachelor’s degree in science and/or MSW degree
2   Skills required:
Data collection from field and hospital
Accessing information
Work organisation
Time management skills
Communication skills
Data entry skills computer
Working knowledge of Marathi and English is desirable
3   Experience :     2 years of relevant experience.
The criteria regarding years of experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates with relevant education, subject to the discretion of the selection panel.
Remuneration
– Rs. 1,68,000 for six months in monthly instalments
80% for data collection from field and hospital
20% for core form completion
Job description
:
Abstraction of medical records of OPD and IPD patients.
Filling the POCSS (Breast cancer & Oral cancer) core form
Maintaining data confidentially and adhering to data protection policies.
Assisting in retrieving and organising data for reports, audits, trainings, workshops and meetings.
Collaborating with team members to resolve data related issues and improve process.
Follow up of patients via phone calls, home visits, whenever need be.
Attend regular staff trainings and other meetings as requested.
The interested candidates shall apply by 7
th
August 2026 through the following Google form link by filling the prescribed application form and attaching their latest CV and statement of intent.
https://forms.gle/XRZ8YpPDLTYNde4S9
Only qualified candidates will be called for written/ practical examination and/or interview at Pathology Department, Sevagram and will need to produce their original certificates of qualification and experience.  No TA/DA will be paid for this purpose.
Dr. Anshu
Principal Investigator- HBCR
Director-Professor
Department of Pathology,
MGIMS, Sevagram
Wardha – 442102
